title: Befuddled: Alternated
description: Adjusts Origins and other gameplay mechanics to better fit the survival experience of the Befuddled Modpack
body: Befuddled: Alternated is a Datapack that overhauls the Origins mod races, better fitting them for the survival experience. Each race is tailored to some aspect of gameplay, from combat, to mining, to adventuring, there exists something for all players, without diminishing any other aspect from them either.
